notes: Read SKILL.md (the only file) in full. Guidance and C# samples for the Azure.ResourceManager.Fabric management-plane SDK: authenticating an ArmClient, creating, reading, scaling, suspending/resuming, deleting and listing Microsoft Fabric capacities, name availability, SKU listing and error handling.

Medium because SKILL.md:21-24 (and the table at SKILL.md:337-340) give `dotnet add package` commands for official NuGet packages, including a `--prerelease` Microsoft.Fabric.Api option. The ARM create/update/suspend/delete calls are sample code for the user's application, not commands the agent runs; credentials come from DefaultAzureCredential and placeholder env vars, and the skill says never to hardcode them.
Running the samples provisions billable Fabric capacity (e.g. F64/F128) and can delete it; users should confirm SKU, region and resource names. No hidden content or external file dependencies.
